description_en: Modifies an IP address whitelist template
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-global-security-ip-group --resource-group-id rg-0000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-ig-name test_123 --global-security-group-id g-zsldxfiwjmti0kcm0000 --gip-list 192.168.0.1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyGlobalSecurityIPGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP address whitelist template. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must consist of lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).

It must start with a letter and end with a letter or a digit.

It must be 2 to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
IP白名单模板名称。IP白名单模板名称需满足如下要求：

由小写字母、数字、下划线（_）组成。

由字母开头、字母或数字结尾。

长度为2~120个字符
parameters.name: global_ig_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP address whitelist template
parameters.name: global_security_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist template.

Separate multiple IP addresses with commas. A maximum of 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks can be added to all IP address whitelists
parameters.help_zh:
白名单模板内的IP地址。

多个IP地址需要用英文逗号隔开，所有IP白名单累积支持添加1000个IP地址或地址段
parameters.name: gip_list
